coverage.reason: Interpreted as the announced SFC exemption, its instrument definition, addressed population and duration.
Interpreted the original commencement and alignment rationale; insignificant exposures describe the policy rationale, without establishing an individual eligibility threshold.
EU background: monitoring and periodic reporting qualify the described EU exemption, without express incorporation into the SFC exemption.
UK background: indefinite duration describes the UK exemption and does not replace the SFC until-further-notice limitation.
Interpreted as announced future amendment and gazettal; their independent legal significance remains unresolved.
Provides a contact route for queries, without making consultation or case-officer approval an exemption condition.
Identifies the margin regime to which the exemption attaches; the incorporated provisions are unavailable.
Citation supporting EU background; referenced authority contents are not supplied.
Citation supporting UK background; referenced policy statement contents are not supplied.
Defines the technical standards referenced in the UK background, without incorporating them into SFC eligibility.

dimensions.explanation: The circular addresses licensed corporations. Classification and underlying transaction, counterparty and requirement scope depend on the unavailable Code provisions.
The collective definition covers non-centrally cleared single-stock, equity basket and equity index options. The UK technical-standards definition serves overseas background only.

The exemption attaches to the identified SFC margin requirements for the listed options. EU reporting qualifications attach locally to the EU exemption. Neither insignificant exposures nor the query-contact instruction supplies an additional SFC eligibility condition.

The text announces what the SFC will exempt and future corresponding Code changes. It supports an announcement-applicability control; independent legal effectiveness cannot be settled from this packet.
The announced period begins inclusively on 2026-01-04 and continues until further notice. Subsequent-notice status is unknown. EU permanence and UK indefinite duration do not override that wording.

Part III of Schedule 10, including paragraph 7(e), is required to resolve underlying applicability and implementation. Overseas authorities remain background dependencies. The three opaque missing identifiers cannot be mapped to named authorities from the packet.

questions: What do Part III of Schedule 10 and paragraph 7(e) establish about classified licensed corporations, relevant margin obligations and any transitional qualifications?
What legal effect does the announced exemption have pending amendment and gazettal, and what implementation documents subsequently took effect?
Has any further SFC notice effective by the selected assessment date displaced this announced exemption for the selected transaction?
Which authorities, if any, correspond to missing.60583204ae3dc30d17bad37f, missing.3fa08e37cc9ca8964c94abb9 and missing.4dd72c04a8ea00444bb6b1a9?

assumptions: The selected control evaluates applicability of the announced exemption, conditional on underlying regime scope; it does not determine independent legal force or overall compliance.
The commencement date is inclusive and evaluated at the assessment date.
Alignment describes the policy approach and does not incorporate every overseas qualification.
Unknown underlying scope and later-notice facts remain unknown.

citations.quote: it will exempt non-centrally cleared single-stock options, equity basket options and equity index options (collectively, “non-centrally cleared equity options”) from its margin requirements1 from 4 January 2026 until further notice
considering that licensed corporations’ exposures to non-centrally cleared equity options are currently insignificant

In the EU, a permanent exemption from the requirement to exchange margin for single-stock equity options and equity index options became effective on 24 December 2024, subject to monitoring and periodic reporting2.
It implemented an indefinite exemption from the UK bilateral margining requirements for single-stock equity options and index options.
Paragraph 7(e) of Part III of Schedule 10 to the Code of Conduct will be amended accordingly and gazetted in due course.
Should you have any queries regarding the contents of this circular, please contact your case officer.
1 As set out in Part III of Schedule 10 to the Code of Conduct for Persons Licensed by or Registered with the Securities and Futures Commission (Code of Conduct).

readings.distinction: The exception-attachment investigation retains the parent's substantive control. A rival importing EU monitoring and reporting would deny eligibility when those conditions fail, but their sentence expressly concerns the EU. An exposure-based rival would deny eligibility for significant exposures, but the source supplies a policy observation rather than a threshold. Requiring case-officer approval or completed gazettal likewise lacks an express eligibility link. These hypotheses are not retained as source-supported alternatives. The strongest unresolved issue is the missing Code and implementation evidence, which prevents a conclusion about legal completeness.

facts.meaning: Whether the selected actor is a licensed corporation for purposes of this SFC announcement at the assessment date.
facts.name: actor_is_licensed_corporation

facts.meaning: Whether the selected transaction and margin requirement fall within the referenced Part III of Schedule 10 margin regime apart from the announced equity-options exemption, including underlying actor classifications and other applicable scope limits.
facts.name: within_referenced_margin_regime

facts.meaning: Whether the selected transaction is a single-stock option, equity basket option or equity index option.
facts.name: is_listed_equity_option

facts.meaning: Whether the selected option is non-centrally cleared at the assessment date.
facts.name: is_non_centrally_cleared

facts.meaning: The date for which the selected exemption-applicability control is evaluated.
facts.name: assessment_date

facts.meaning: Whether a further SFC notice effective by the assessment date has ended or superseded reliance on this announced exemption for the selected actor, transaction and margin requirement. A true value does not decide eligibility under any replacement exemption.
facts.name: further_notice_displaces_announced_exemption

questions: Does the missing Code contain qualifications material to this selected exemption that the announcement does not reproduce?
What evidence establishes underlying regime scope and effective later-notice status for the selected assessment date?
readings.statement: [TRUE_IS_SATISFIED] Selected control: applicability of the announced SFC equity-options margin exemption. Within the declared actor and underlying margin-regime scope, true means the transaction is a listed non-centrally cleared equity option, the assessment date is on or after 2026-01-04, and no effective further notice has displaced reliance on this announcement for it. False means at least one condition fails; it does not establish a margin breach or rule out another exemption. Outside scope the control makes no determination. Unknown inputs remain unknown. EU reporting, insignificant exposure and case-officer consultation are not added as eligibility conditions.
readings.subject: Announced exemption for a selected licensed corporation, option transaction, margin requirement and assessment date
